title: The pure infiniteness transfer problem
summary: Problem 8.4 of Pino, Goodearl, Perera and Molina in [arxiv.org/abs/0806.4156] asks whether a dense subalgebra $A_{0}$ of a $C^*$-algebra $A$ that is purely infinite as a ring forces $A$ to be purely infinite as a $C^*$-algebra. We call this the $\textit{pure infiniteness transfer problem}$, the transfer being from the ring to its $C^*$-completion. The problem is open, even when $A_{0}$ is unital and simple. We settle it under two hypotheses: $A$ has real rank zero, and $A_{0}$ is closed under holomorphic functional calculus. Under these hypotheses $A_{0}$ is purely infinite simple as a ring…
